title: C lichen_frame_write error-category precedence differs from Rust for E=1 frames
description: Diagnostics parity only (both always reject). C validate addr_mode/mic_length/signer_iid BEFORE encrypted-check so malformed E=1 yields -EINVAL; Rust checks encryption first yielding EncryptedUnsupported; Python raises EncryptedFrameError first. File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/frame.c:146 write path. Acceptance or explicit documentation of intentional precedence.
